warnings: Road to Kunzum & Rohtang passes can be slippery in August thunderstorms – carry chains and drive cautiously.
Altitude above 3,500 m in Kaza, Langza, Kibber – monitor for AMS, keep hydrated, and have acetazolamide if prescribed.
Shared jeep fares often inflated; negotiate price (₹2,200‑₹2,500 per seat) or pre‑book shared seats (₹2,000‑₹2,500).
Ki Monastery entrance has 200 m of stone steps – wear sturdy shoes; consider skipping inner courtyard if uncomfortable.
Local vendors may overcharge for photography or fossil purchases – agree on price beforehand or decline.

Taxi/private cab pricing inflation – ₹12,000‑₹15,000 for the 200 km Manali→Kaza journey; meter not used, so prices can be inflated. Mitigation: negotiate the fare before boarding or choose the shared jeep (₹2,000‑₹2,500 per seat) which offers a transparent rate.

Ki Monastery unofficial guide overcharging – vendors near the entrance charge for guided tours. Mitigation: insist on a free self‑guided visit; if a guide is required, hire a certified guide from the Kaza Tourist Office (₹500‑₹800 per day) and confirm the fee beforehand.

Ki Monastery steep access – 200 m of stone steps and uneven flooring; not suitable for toddlers or mobility‑limited elderly. Mitigation: visit early morning, use walking support, or consider skipping the inner courtyard if mobility is limited.

Kibber inflated photography fees – local guides demand payment for a few minutes of picture‑taking. Mitigation: politely decline; most locals pose for free. If a professional photographer is needed, agree on a fixed rate beforehand.

Langza Fossil Park fossil‑selling overpricing – ‘exclusive’ stalls near the entrance overprice genuine specimens. Mitigation: do not purchase on impulse; buy only from the official park kiosk where prices are listed (₹200‑₹500 per specimen).

Chandratal unofficial entry permit – local youths often demand a fee double the official ₹200 vehicle charge. Mitigation: show the official ₹200 receipt; if a permit is requested, refuse and report the incident to the nearest police outpost.

Tabo Monastery mandatory souvenir claim – shop claims a souvenir purchase as entry fee. Mitigation: pay only the official entry fee (₹30/adult, ₹15/child 3‑10 y); buy any souvenirs separately at the market where prices are transparent.
Dietary: Tibetan‑influenced cuisine (thukpa, momos, skyu) uses yak butter and apricot preserves; vegetarian options are limited—always request ‘veg only’ to avoid hidden meat broth in thukpa or skyu.

Medical: Kaza Primary Health Centre offers 24‑hour basic care only; serious emergencies require travel to Manali (~200 km) or Shimla (~300 km). Air evacuation via the Kaza helipad is possible but weather‑dependent. Carry personal altitude‑sickness medication (acetazolamide), a basic first‑aid kit, extra water, and high‑energy snacks.
Transport: Shared jeeps from Manali to Kaza depart at 06:00 hrs and fill quickly in peak season; book seats early or be prepared for waiting.
Altitude: Although the gradual ascent via Manali helps prevent altitude‑related discomfort, travellers should still monitor for symptoms of AMS and be ready to descend if needed.
